integrity: All-prime statements derived analytically from cyclotomic divisibility, cubic permutation classification, quadratic Gauss sums and Fourier diagonalization. Finite exact checks supplement, not replace, proof. External publication priority uncertain.
limitations: Prime orders p>=5; complex-linear full Gabor intensity lifting, not unrestricted nonlinear phase-retrieval failure; specialized quartic chirp, no prime-power extrapolation. Exact small-prime specialization may be covered by prior one-coordinate results.
title: Exact Gabor lifting ranks and fourth ambiguity moments of quartic prime-field chirps
